issue_context.title: BUG: `Series.__delete__` with EA casts to object
issue_context.body:
it calls np.delete, which casts to ndarray, which for e.g. PeriodDtype will cast to object

```
dti = pd.date_range("2016-01-01", periods=3, tz="US/Pacific")
ser = pd.Series(dti)

del ser[1]

>>> ser
0    2016-01-01 00:00:00-08:00
2    2016-01-03 00:00:00-08:00
dtype: object
```

review_comments: 2 bad you have to do this (create a nother block type), any better way (e.g. handle it in the EA impl)?
there are actually a few other methods im planning to move here to share between ExtensionBlock/NDArrayBackedExtensionBlock.  I think the code de-duplication makes this a net plus
maybe worthile adding all EA types here?
ill add a test in the extension tests next pass
